name: FUN_PARALLEL_CHUNK_DATA
description: This table contains the candidate data for processing. The data is segmented by the chunk.

columns.name: PARALLEL_RUN_ID
columns.description: Parallel run to which this data belongs.

columns.name: CHUNK_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the current chunk.

columns.name: DATA_KEY
columns.description: Unique value that represents a specific piece of data. It can also be a concatenated series of values.

columns.name: DATA_COST
columns.description: Estimated relative cost of processing a piece of data compared to other pieces of data.

columns.name: DATA_CHAR1
columns.description: First set of supplemental character data to help identify or join to the row of a chunk.

columns.name: DATA_CHAR2
columns.description: Second set of supplemental character data to help identify or join to the row of a chunk.

columns.name: DATA_CHAR3
columns.description: Third set of supplemental character data to help identify or join to the row of a chunk.

columns.name: DATA_CHAR4
columns.description: Fourth set of supplemental character data to help identify or join to the row of a chunk.

columns.name: DATA_CHAR5
columns.description: Fifth set of supplemental character data to help identify or join to the row of a chunk.

columns.name: DATA_NUMBER1
columns.description: First set of supplemental numeric data to help identify or join to the row of a chunk.

columns.name: DATA_NUMBER2
columns.description: Second set of supplemental numeric data to help identify or join to the row of a chunk.

columns.name: DATA_NUMBER3
columns.description: Third set of supplemental numeric data to help identify or join to the row of a chunk.

columns.name: DATA_NUMBER4
columns.description: Fourth set of supplemental numeric data to help identify or join to the row of a chunk.

columns.name: DATA_NUMBER5
columns.description: Fifth set of supplemental numeric data to help identify or join to the row of a chunk.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
